stem:
The box plots show the lengths of the songs on two digital music players in minutes.

Lengths of Songs on Digital Music Players

Music Player X
Music Player Y

Number of Minutes
instruction: Which statement is best supported by the information in the box plots?

options.label: F
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for Music Player X is equal to the interquartile range of the data for Music Player Y.

options.label: G
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for Music Player X is greater than the interquartile range of the data for Music Player Y.

options.label: H
options.text: The median length of the songs on Music Player X is equal to the median length of the songs on Music Player Y.

options.label: J
options.text: The median length of the songs on Music Player X is less than the median length of the songs on Music Player Y.

visual_elements: box plot showing lengths of songs for Music Player X and Music Player Y with a number line from 3.5 to 7.5 minutes
